title: Fated Twins
next_chapter_hook: Chen Tieming's voice stopped abruptly, his remnant soul trembling slightly—on the first page of the Tianji Record, Mo Xiansheng's handwriting was slowly emerging, yet it was none of the records he was familiar with.

text.content:
The night wind carried a scent of blood, seeping through the gaps of the shattered battle flags into Chen Ji's robes. He stood on the cliff edge of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, below was an abyss of countless zhang, behind him flickered spiritual lanterns. But his gaze was firmly fixed on that blurry figure beneath the black demonic banner three hundred li away—a face that overlapped in his deepest memories with that little girl who wore double buns and chased after him calling 'big brother.'

Chen Nian. His sister. Chen Nian, who was taken by the Holy Sect and sealed for years as the 'Heavenly Fate Key.'

But the demonic path commander was clearly a man.

dialogue.content:
What you see is correct.

Mo Xiansheng's voice rose幽幽 from the first page's remnant soul, aged and weary, yet carrying an unprecedented solemnity: That demonic path commander is Chen Nian's other half soul. To be precise—it is your shared other half.

Shared?

Chen Ji's voice was terribly hoarse, he gripped the Tianji Record fragment tightly, his knuckles turning white. What do you mean by shared other half? Chen Nian is my sister, the only bloodline of the Chen family—

He stopped abruptly.

Because he remembered a detail he had never pondered deeply: Why could Chen Nian, from birth, interfere with the Tianji Record's foresight? Why did her existence always blur the images of fate?

Fated Twins.

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul drifted slowly out from the first page, forming a pale blue wisp of light. He gazed at the distant demonic banner, his voice low like an ancient funeral bell: One soul, two bodies. The Heavenly Dao tore the complete soul in half, giving half to you, half to Chen Nian.

From the moment you were born, this chess game was destined.

So the Holy Sect took Chen Nian, not for any 'Heavenly Fate Key'—

Chen Ji abruptly raised his head, his eyes blazing with brilliant light. It was the Heavenly Dao's arrangement. The Holy Sect was merely the executor. That so-called 'Key' is actually a seal, sealing away my chance to find the other half.

Clever.

Mo Xiansheng let out a low laugh, yet it sounded more like crying: The Heavenly Dao never does useless things. It separated you, not for destruction, but for deeper torment. It wants you to fight each other without knowing, until one is completely annihilated.

Only then can the fetters of fate be loosened.

text.content:
Chen Ji fell silent.

He thought of his layouts over these years—every step meticulously planned, every move precisely hitting fate's nodes. But it turned out he had never stepped off the chessboard. He thought he was the Chess Player, yet he was merely the most important piece in the Heavenly Dao's game.

And his sister who had been missing for years was, from start to finish, the opponent on the other side of the board.

He suddenly laughed, that laughter echoing in the night wind, desolate and mad.

choice.prompt: Faced with this earth-shattering truth, Chen Ji needed to make a decision—how should he face this 'other half' intertwined with his fate?

choices.description: Chen Ji refused to believe fate was unsolvable. He wanted to find a plan that was neither unification nor annihilation, using wisdom to pry open the rules of the Heavenly Dao.
choices.visible_cost: Consume a large amount of Heavenly Fate to deduce possibilities
choices.risk_hint: May expose the weaknesses of the Tianji Record, attracting the Heavenly Dao's attention

text.content:
Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, his fingers pressed against the fragment. Heavenly Fate flowed away like water, and a blurry image gradually formed in his mind—that was the third possibility beyond unification and annihilation, existing within the cracks of the Heavenly Dao's rules.

But that crack was barely visible.

choices.text: Proactively contact the Demonic Path Commander
choices.description: Since conflict is inevitable, better to strike first. Chen Ji decided to take a risk and go to the demonic army's camp to probe the 'other half's' true intentions.
choices.visible_cost: Going alone, possibly a one-way trip
choices.visible_reward: Obtain first-hand intelligence on the Fated Twins
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path Commander's strength is unfathomable, Chen Ji has no chance of winning

dialogue.content:
Mo Xiansheng.

Chen Ji suddenly spoke, his voice recovering its usual calm, even with a hint of playfulness: If I die at the hands of the Demonic Path Commander, whose hands will the Tianji Record fall into?

choices.description: Chen Nian is the key—her other half soul is occupied by the Demonic Path Commander. If her original consciousness can be awakened, perhaps it can collapse the enemy from within.
choices.visible_cost: Need to return to the sect's core area, taking three days
choices.visible_reward: Activate the true power of the 'Heavenly Fate Key' within Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: The sect is already under Ling Yuan's surveillance, action may be exposed

text.content:
Chen Ji's gaze suddenly softened, that was a side he rarely showed. Chen Nian's fate that she endured alone all these years was far heavier than his. If unification meant losing oneself, then he would rather—

Make that man disappear.

dialogue.content:
No matter which path you choose, there is one fact I must tell you.

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul suddenly trembled violently, his voice becoming urgent and sharp: The Demonic Path Commander knows of your existence. He has known from the very beginning. His summoning of Chen Nian was not for reunion—it's to test your reaction.

He is confirming whether you are qualified to be his opponent.

text.content:
Test?

Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, a cold smile curling his lips. A堂堂 Demonic Path Commander, ruler of a hundred thousand demonic army, actually testing the depth of a Tianqing Sect Menial Servant?

This is either the enemy's arrogance, or— he truly sensed something.

Like that intangible connection between Fated Twins.

dialogue.content:
Interesting.

Chen Ji suddenly laughed softly, that laughter especially harsh in the silent night. He stroked the cracks on the fragment, his movements gentle as if caressing a priceless treasure: Since he wants to test, let him test.

I want to see if the hunter shows any weakness when the prey actively reveals its fangs.

choice.prompt: In what manner did Chen Ji decide to respond to the Demonic Path Commander's test?

choices.text: Feign weakness to draw the enemy deeper
choices.description: Continue playing thetrash character, lure the Demonic Path Commander to relax his guard, seeking a fatal opportunity.
choices.visible_cost: Must endure the humiliation of being despised
choices.visible_reward: Gain the Demonic Path Commander's contempt, may expose his fatal weakness
choices.risk_hint: The enemy may see through the act and turn the tables

dialogue.content: Feigning weakness is the best offense. When the opponent thinks they control the overall situation, that is when they are most vulnerable.

choices.text: Direct confrontation and declaration of war
choices.description: Confront the Demonic Path Commander face-to-face with the identity of Fated Twins, forcing him to state his position, breaking the current deadlock.
choices.visible_cost: Expose that one knows the truth, entering the final battle phase early
choices.visible_reward: Shock the three great sects, establishing Chen Ji's true status
choices.risk_hint: May attract the Heavenly Dao's more intense intervention

text.content: Once the news spreads, the entire cultivation world would be shaken. Thetrash disciple of Tianqing Sect is actually one of the Fated Twins? What expressions would those who once bullied him have?

dialogue.content:
There is one more thing.

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul suddenly dimmed, his voice becoming ethereal: Your Heavenly Fate has dropped below thirty. Every use of the Tianji Record is透支 your life force.

And either unification or annihilation requires... everything.

text.content:
Chen Ji's footsteps stopped.

He slowly turned, his gaze falling on that flickering remnant soul. The night wind howled past, stirring his thin garments, yet could not disperse the deep coldness in his eyes.

Everything...

He repeated these two words softly, then suddenly laughed. That smile held no despair, no anger, only a kind of近乎crazed calm.

Then we definitely cannot act according to the script the Heavenly Dao has written.

choice.prompt: Facing this unsolvable dead end of the Heavenly Dao, Chen Ji chose—

choices.text: Defy heaven and change fate, build anew
choices.description: Completely abandon clues from Tianyi Pavilion, independently explore methods to break through the Heavenly Fate limit, walk a path no one has walked before.
choices.visible_cost: Abandon all known advantages and layouts
choices.visible_reward: May discover a third possibility beyond 'unification or annihilation'
choices.risk_hint: The path ahead is unknown, may walk into an even greater dead end

text.content: The Heavenly Dao wanted him to choose, so it definitely wouldn't let him choose. Chen Ji never played by the rules—this was his greatest weakness, and also his greatest advantage.

choices.text: Enter the game personally, draw out the snake
choices.description: Deliberately expose the Tianji Record's existence, lure the Heavenly Dao itself to act, seeking counterattack opportunities when the enemy shows weakness.
choices.visible_cost: Become the common target of both the Heavenly Dao and the Demonic Path Commander
choices.visible_reward: May simultaneously obtain crucial intelligence against both sides
choices.risk_hint: Extremely likely to be a death trap

dialogue.content: The most dangerous road is often the shortest. Since both the Heavenly Dao and that Demonic Path Commander want to devour me—let them bite each other first.

choices.text: Temporarily avoid the edge, plan slowly
choices.description: Return to Tianqing Sect, use existing resources and allies to lay plans, first solve Ling Yuan the internal threat, then scheme about the Fated Twins matter.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the best timing, letting the Demonic Path Commander act first
choices.visible_reward: Stabilize the rear, eliminate hidden dangers before striking with full force
choices.risk_hint: The longer the delay, the more Heavenly Fate is consumed

text.content: Old Sect Master Ling Yuan's threat still hangs overhead. If even the rear cannot be protected, what chance is there against fate? First eliminate internal troubles, then slay external enemies.

Chen Ji took a deep breath, pressing all tangled thoughts into his heart. He raised his head to gaze at the distant demonic banner, his gaze as calm as a still deep pool.

No matter what the path ahead holds, his choice has only ever been one—be no chess piece, acknowledge no fate. Even if he must oppose the entire Heavenly Dao, he will personally tear apart this so-called destiny.

Because he is Chen Ji.

The Chen Ji who crawled out from thetrash pile, who planned meticulously.

The night wind howled past, dispersing the blood lingering in the battlefield. A line of white appeared at the horizon, a new day is about to begin. And on fate's chessboard, the most crucial move is already at hand.

Just then, the Tianji Record fragment suddenly vibrated violently.

An unprecedented message flooded into Chen Ji's mind—it was a divine sense transmitted by the Demonic Path Commander through some forbidden method, brief and direct:

'I await you. In three days, at the Soul-Cliff.'

Chen Tieming's remnant soul blanched: The Tianji Record's aura... leaked? He can actually track here?!

dialogue.content:
No.

Chen Ji suddenly laughed, that smile carrying a strange excitement. He gripped the fragment tightly, his voice low and dangerous: Not leaked, he has been waiting all along. Waiting for me to see the truth, waiting for me to make my choice.

He was confirming whether I am his opponent.

Now, he has confirmed.

text.content: Chen Tieming's voice stopped abruptly, his remnant soul trembling slightly—on the first page of the Tianji Record, Mo Xiansheng's handwriting was slowly emerging, yet it was none of the records he was familiar with.
